refnamediv.refpurpose: API for enrolling credentials into LUKS2 volumes via systemd-cryptenroll.

refsect1.title: Description
refsect1.para: io.systemd.CryptEnroll is a Varlink interface implemented by systemd1-related components. It can be introspected and called with varlinkctl1.
API for enrolling credentials into LUKS2 volumes via systemd-cryptenroll.

refsect1.title: Interface Definition
refsect1.para: The following interface definition is exposed:
refsect1.programlisting:
# API for enrolling credentials into LUKS2 volumes via systemd-cryptenroll. interface io.systemd.CryptEnroll
# The credential types this interface knows about, used both as the enrollment mechanism and as the slot type reported by ListSlots. type EnrollMechanism( # A regular passphrase password, # A randomly generated recovery key recovery, # A PKCS#11 security token (not enrollable via this interface) pkcs11, # A FIDO2 security token fido2, # A TPM2 device (not enrollable via this interface) tpm2 )
# Enroll a credential into a LUKS2 volume. When enrolling a FIDO2 token that requires user presence, the call must be made with the 'more' flag, so that the server can report when a touch is required via a 'touch' state notification. # [Supports 'more' flag] method Enroll( # Path to the LUKS2 block device or image to operate on. node: string, # Which kind of credential to enroll. Only 'password', 'recovery' and 'fido2' may be enrolled via this interface for now; 'pkcs11' and 'tpm2' are rejected with an InvalidParameter error, currently. mechanism: EnrollMechanism, # How to unlock the volume for the enrollment operation is inferred from which of the following fields are set: setting unlockPassword unlocks via that password, unlockKeyFile/unlockKeyFileDescriptor via a key file, unlockFido2Device via FIDO2, unlockTpm2Device via TPM2. Exactly one must be set. unlockPassword: ?string, # Path to a key file to unlock the volume with. unlockKeyFile: ?string, # Index into the file descriptors passed along with this call, identifying a key file to unlock the volume with. unlockKeyFileDescriptor: ?int, # Path to a FIDO2 device to unlock the volume with. Leave the path empty to automatically discover a suitable device. unlockFido2Device: ?string, # Path to a TPM2 device to unlock the volume with. Leave the path empty to automatically discover a suitable device. unlockTpm2Device: ?string, # The passphrase to enroll, when mechanism is 'password'. Contains key material. password: ?string, # A recovery key to enroll, when mechanism is 'recovery'. The key must be in the normalized form and have high entropy. Use MakeRecoveryKey() to generate the recovery key. Contains key material. recoveryKey: ?string, # Path to the FIDO2 device to enroll, when mechanism is 'fido2'. Leave empty to automatically discover a suitable device. fido2Device: ?string, # The FIDO2 token PIN to use for enrollment. Contains key material. fido2Pin: ?string, # Whether unlocking the FIDO2 enrollment shall require a client PIN. Defaults to true. fido2WithClientPin: ?bool, # Whether unlocking the FIDO2 enrollment shall require user presence (touch). Defaults to true. fido2WithUserPresence: ?bool, # Whether unlocking the FIDO2 enrollment shall require user verification. Defaults to false. fido2WithUserVerification: ?bool, # Explicit list of keyslot indexes to wipe after enrolling. wipeSlots: ?[]int, # Wipe all already-enrolled slots of these types after enrolling. wipeTypes: ?[]EnrollMechanism, # Controls whether interactive authentication (via polkit) shall be allowed. If unspecified defaults to false. allowInteractiveAuthentication: ?bool ) -> ( # The keyslot the new credential was enrolled into. Set on the terminating reply only. slot: ?int, # The keyslots wiped as part of this call, if any. wipedSlots: ?[]int, # The generated recovery key or the provided recovery key, when mechanism is 'recovery'. Contains key material. recoveryKey: ?string, # Progress indicator, only sent on intermediate replies when 'more' was set. Currently the only value is 'touch', signalling that the FIDO2 token is waiting for a touch. Unset on the terminating reply. state: ?string )
# Enumerate the keyslots currently enrolled in a LUKS2 volume, one per reply. Must be called with the 'more' flag. # [Requires 'more' flag] method ListSlots( # Path to the LUKS2 block device or image to operate on. node: string ) -> ( # A currently enrolled keyslot index. slot: ?int, # The type of the keyslot. type: ?EnrollMechanism )
# Generate a recovery key that can be enrolled using the 'recovery' mechanism in Enroll(). method MakeRecoveryKey() -> ( # The generated recovery key. recoveryKey: string )
# The volume is managed by another subsystem (e.g. systemd-homed) and may not be enrolled into directly. error VolumeUnderForeignManagement()
# A password is required to unlock the volume, but none was provided. error PasswordRequired()
# The provided password did not unlock the volume. error PasswordIncorrect()
# No matching FIDO2 device was found. error FidoDeviceNotFound()
# The FIDO2 token was not interacted with in time. error FidoActionTimeout()

refsect1.title: Examples
refsect1.para: varlinkctl introspect SERVICE io.systemd.CryptEnroll shows the interface definition as served by SERVICE, and varlinkctl call SERVICE io.systemd.CryptEnroll.Enroll '{}' invokes its Enroll() method.

refsect1.title: History
refsect1.para: The io.systemd.CryptEnroll interface was added in version 262.
Enroll(), EnrollMechanism, FidoActionTimeout, FidoDeviceNotFound, ListSlots(), PasswordIncorrect, PasswordRequired, and VolumeUnderForeignManagement were added in version 262.
